title: Care Corner Singapore
content: Care Corner is a designated Integrated Community Care Programme (ICCP) provider. Services include community rehabilitation, dementia day care, home personal care, and caregiver support. Contact: 6353 1180. Multiple centres across Singapore.

title: Agency for Integrated Care (AIC)
content: AIC connects seniors and caregivers to community care services. Call the AIC hotline at 1800-650-6060 or visit CareHub at www.aic.sg for referrals to home care, day care, and rehabilitation services. Also manages the CareLine befriending service.

title: Dementia Singapore
content: Dementia Singapore (formerly Alzheimer's Disease Association) provides dementia day care centres, home care, caregiver training workshops, and a 24-hour helpline at 6377 0700. They also run support groups for caregivers of persons with dementia.

title: SG Enable — Disability Support Services
content: SG Enable supports persons with disabilities through employment assistance, training, and social integration programmes. For seniors with disabilities, services include day activity centres, early intervention, and supported employment. Contact: 6511 5100.

title: Silver Ribbon Singapore — Mental Health
content: Silver Ribbon provides mental health support including counselling, befriending services, and caregiver support groups for seniors. Helpline: 6385 3714. Services are available in English and Mandarin.

title: Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS)
content: CHAS allows Singapore Citizens to receive subsidies for medical and dental care at participating GP and dental clinics. Seniors 65 and above qualify for Pioneer Generation or Merdeka Generation subsidies. Apply via HealthHub or call 1800-275-2427.

title: Home Care Services — AIC Partners
content: Home care services include personal care (bathing, grooming), nursing care, and therapy at home. Available through AIC-accredited providers. Subsidies are available based on financial assessment. Apply through a social worker or AIC directly.

title: Senior Activity Centres (SACs)
content: Senior Activity Centres provide a gathering place for seniors, especially those living alone. Services include recreational activities, befriending, referrals to social services, and emergency response alerts. Located in HDB estates island-wide.

title: Meals on Wheels
content: Meals on Wheels delivers nutritious meals to homebound seniors who are unable to cook for themselves. Available through various voluntary welfare organisations (VWOs) island-wide. Contact AIC at 1800-650-6060 for referral.

title: Medical Social Workers (MSWs)
content: Medical social workers at polyclinics and hospitals help seniors and caregivers navigate care options, apply for subsidies, and manage transitions from hospital to community care. Ask at your nearest polyclinic or hospital.
